title: S00-01 - The Job
hook: At the edge of the warded road, a woman waits beside a loaded carriage. She looks like your contact for this job, but she has not introduced herself yet.

blocks.label: Where You Are
blocks.body: At the edge of the warded road, a woman waits beside a loaded carriage. She looks like your contact for this job, but she has not introduced herself yet.

blocks.label: Plain Stakes
blocks.body: The party meets their contact by description, receives the sealed package, asks questions, and agrees to roll out.

blocks.label: Visible Options
blocks.body: Ask questions about the crate Accept the job without question Try to inspect the seal
